description: This Java source file defines the class CreateXmlResourceDialog, which is a dialog window used in Android development within IntelliJ IDEA for creating new XML resource files. It manages user input for resource name, type, target directories, and file name, including validation and resource existence checks.

classes.name: CreateXmlResourceDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for creating new Android XML resources, handling user input, directory management, validation, and resource existence checks.

methods.name: resetFromFile
methods.description: Initializes dialog fields based on a given file, setting module and directory selections accordingly.

methods.name: doDeleteDirectory
methods.description: Deletes the selected resource directory from the resource folder.

methods.name: doSelectAllDirs
methods.description: Selects all resource directories in the list.

methods.name: doUnselectAllDirs
methods.description: Unselects all resource directories in the list.

methods.name: doAddNewDirectory
methods.description: Adds a new resource directory to the resource folder.

methods.name: updateDirectories
methods.description: Refreshes the list of resource directories based on the current module and resource folder.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates user input before creating a resource, including name correctness and resource existence.

methods.name: checkIfResourceAlreadyExists
methods.description: Checks if a resource with the same name already exists in the selected directories.

methods.name: getResourceName
methods.description: Returns the resource name entered by the user.

methods.name: getDirNames
methods.description: Returns a list of selected directory names.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the resource value entered by the user.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the selected module or the module associated with the dialog.
